headline: In South Korea, a Fund Proposal to Protect Workers Threatened by Artificial Intelligence
summary: Several South Korean lawmakers propose a national solidarity fund for workers threatened by AI-linked job cuts. The fund would be financed partly by contributions requested from companies that replace workers with AI.
why: Labor policy and levies on automation affect companies' costs and their hiring and technology investment decisions.
